title: A Cross-Architecture Audit of Direction-Based Inference-Time Defences in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.27910v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inference time defences against vision language model jailbreaks often subtract a calibrated direction from the residual stream at a chosen decoder layer. We compare five defence candidates across 15 model and layer cells from four architectural families under a magnitude controlled protocol that matches the intervention size for each prompt and pairs every direction with a random control of the same norm. The candidates are the mean image conditioning shift, a CMRM style refusal direction, a ShiftDC style attack specific residual, a prompt instruction to ignore the image, and a random control. No single candidate dominates on both refusal recovery and utility preservation. The image conditioning shift leads on LLaVA 1.5 and Pixtral 12B and is the only candidate whose utility loss remains at the measurement noise floor in every family. The prompt instruction leads on Qwen2.5 VL, while the attack specific residual leads on Qwen2 VL 2B

translated_title: 跨架构审计：视觉语言模型中基于方向的推理时防御方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.27910v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：针对视觉语言模型越狱的推理时防御通常会在选定的解码器层从残差流中减去一个校准方向。我们在一个幅度受控的协议下，比较了来自四个架构家族的15个模型和层单元中的五种防御候选方法，该协议匹配每个提示的干预大小，并将每个方向与相同范数的随机对照配对。这些候选方法包括平均图像条件偏移、CMRM风格拒绝方向、ShiftDC风格攻击特定残差、提示指令忽略图像以及随机对照。没有单一候选方法在拒绝恢复和实用性保持上同时占据优势。图像条件偏移在LLaVA 1.5和Pixtral 12B上表现领先，并且是唯一一个在每个家族中实用性损失保持在测量噪声底部的候选方法。提示指令在Qwen2.5 VL上表现领先，而攻击特定残差在Qwen2 VL 2B上表现领先。
tldr: 本文系统比较了五种基于方向的推理时防御方法在多种视觉语言模型上的表现，发现没有一种方法在所有情况下都最优，但图像条件偏移在保持实用性方面最稳健。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares five direction-based inference-time defenses across various vision-language models, finding that no single method dominates in all cases, while the image conditioning shift is most robust in preserving utility.
